correctness.rationale: For the shared-versus-independent parent coupling, the paired same-label degree polynomial has exact drift with collision correction (1−alpha)(z−1)(w−1) Z_n/n². Its normalized coefficients converge by triangular stochastic approximation to Q_alpha=1/[3−alpha−(1−alpha)(z+w)−alpha zw]. Conditional innovation cross bracket = alpha(z−1)(w−1)(Z_n/n−F1_n F2_n/n²), giving S_alpha=alpha(1−z)(1−w)(Q_alpha−P(z)P(w)). The fixed-cutoff martingale array with bounded increments and stable drift B=−I+J yields a Gaussian limit, and integration over age t gives C_alpha=S_alpha/(3−z−w). Independently verified with exact symbolic algebra that C_alpha equals the four-denominator rational formula and extracted c00,c01,c11 plus derivative. The proof is finite-dimensional and the direct second-moment recursion supports covariance convergence, not merely weak convergence.
